title: Message enciphered back to front: look-ahead autokey, plain feed d = 1-8 and 34-48 (second clue keys the first, moved -3..3), cipher feed d = 1-68, on 666,993 keyword tableaux; plus multiplier 1-25 with a word of 1-13 on A-Z/KRYPTOS, and one hidden alphabet at d = 1-8
k4_result: A (dictionary tableaux): 0 of 18.49 billion settings pass with 7+ checks (666,993 alphabets x 5 layouts x Vigenere/Beaufort x fed letter numbered in M/A-Z/KRYPTOS x sign x 139 (feed, d, clue shift) tests x word length 1-4). Nothing at d = 42 or anywhere else. B (A-Z/KRYPTOS, multiplier 1-25, word 1-13): 0 of 333,200 settings pass; the most clue pairs that agree on one constant is 7 of 24. C (one hidden alphabet): 320 models, 272 contradicted, 0 consistent with 3+ checks and distinct letter places, 48 undecidable (under 3 checks).
controls: A: 3 shuffled K4s, each on all 666,993 alphabets: 0 settings pass in each. B: 3 shuffled K4s: 0 pass; most pairs on one constant 6, 7, 6 of 24 (K4: 7). C: 20 shuffled K4s: survivors with 3+ checks 0 in 17 of them and 1, 4, 5 in three (K4: 0).
planted: 15/15. A 5/5: plain feed d=3 (17 checks, all 97 letters read back, -4.15), cipher feed d=11 (23 checks, -4.18), plain feed d=42 (10 checks), plain feed d=40 with the second clue moved -2 and a word of 2 (9 checks), cipher feed d=50 with a word of 3 (10 checks), each found on its own tableau among 9,000 sampled alphabets. B 4/4 (8-19 checks, multipliers 3, 11, 25, words of 3-9). C 6/6 (4-9 checks, random hidden alphabets, d = 1-5).
scope_limits: Plain feed is NOT decided at d = 9-12 (5 or fewer checks) and d = 13-33 (no clue pairs at all); cipher feed is not decided at d = 69 and beyond (under 8 pairs). A: dictionary keyword alphabets only (plain, ~cols, ~keyed) plus A-Z and KRYPTOS, five layouts, feed multiplier +-1, word on top of length 1-4 and only where 7+ checks remain (none at plain d = 8 or cipher d = 68); the second clue is moved -3..3 only for plain feed d = 34-48 (for cipher feed d >= 34 moving it changes nothing; for cipher feed d <= 33 it was not moved). B: A-Z and KRYPTOS only. C: hidden alphabet is undecidable for plain feed at d = 3-8 with both sides hidden, d = 7-8 with a hidden plain side, d = 8 with a hidden cipher side, and for cipher feed at d = 7 with both sides hidden; no d beyond 8, no word on top. No transposition before or after, no feed that mixes plaintext and ciphertext, no keyed (varying) distance ahead.

negative.family: Autokey that looks ahead (message enciphered back to front)
negative.hypothesis: K4 was enciphered from its last letter backwards with an autokey, so each key letter is the plaintext or ciphertext letter d places further on (at d = 42 BERLINCLOCK keys EASTNORTHEAST).
negative.scope: Exact test on the clue letters, 7+ checks. Plain feed d = 1-8, and d = 34-48 with the second clue moved -3..3 (8+ pairs); cipher feed d = 1-68; constant or repeating word of 2-4 on top; 666,993 alphabets (A-Z, KRYPTOS, every dictionary keyword alphabet and its two transposition-mixed forms) x 5 layouts x Vigenere/Beaufort x fed letter numbered in M/A-Z/KRYPTOS x added or subtracted: 18.49 billion settings. Also on A-Z/KRYPTOS with any multiplier 1-25 on the fed letter and a word of 1-13 (333,200 settings), and with one hidden alphabet (both sides, or one side against A-Z/KRYPTOS) at d = 1-8, distinct letter places required (320 models).
negative.outcome: Dead in scope: 0 settings pass on dictionary tableaux, 0 on A-Z/KRYPTOS with multipliers (best 7 of 24 pairs on one constant), 0 hidden-alphabet models with 3+ checks; 48 hidden-alphabet models undecidable (controls: 3 shuffled K4s on all alphabets 0 each, near miss 6-7 of 24; 20 shuffled K4s on the hidden test 0-5 survivors; planted 15/15). Not decided: plain feed at d = 9-33.

follow_ups: Plain-feed autokey at distances 9-33 (ahead or back) cannot be tested from the clues, but each clue block chains: with d <= 13 a block of 13 known letters forces every letter at i +- k*d, so for d = 9-13 on a given tableau about 13 * (97/d) letters are forced with NO free primer. Score those forced letters on the big English model over the 667k tableaux, both directions; planted test at d = 11 back to front.
